content_of_post_to_answer: My focus level has reduced terribly. I am unable to concentrate while studying and my exams are around the corner. How can I regain my focus and concentration?
answer: Loss of focus before exams is often not a concentration problem but a pressure problem. When the brain sees studying as a threat with consequences attached, it starts avoiding the task. Try reducing the size of the starting point: study one page, one concept, one question. I've explored this pattern of attention and avoidance in more detail on my profile, if it helps you go deeper. Focus is rarely found first; it is usually rebuilt through small acts of returning.
